blocks.arabic_text: السِّجِلَّاتُ وَثَقُلَتِ الْبِطَاقَةُ وَلَا يَثْقُلُ مَعَ اسْمِ اللهِ شَيْءٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب ماجاء فيمن يموت:٢٦٣٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) says that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “On the Day of Qiyamah Allah will pick out a man from my Ummah and stand him before all the people. Allah will spread out before that man 99 scrolls in which his deeds are recorded. Each will stretch as far as the eye can see. Allah will ask him, “Do you deny anything in these scrolls? Did My angels appointed to record deeds do you any injustice? (Did they write a sin you did not commit? Or did they write more than the sin you committed?)” He will say, “No, my Rabb!” (There is no room to deny, and the angels have done no injustice.) Allah will ask, “Do you have any excuse for your evil deeds?” To that too he will say, “No, my Rabb!” Allah will say, “Very well! We have one good deed of yours with Us. Today no injustice whatsoever will be done to you!” Then a small slip will be brought out on which is written “Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh’. Allah will say, “Have it weighed.” He will ask, “O my Lord! What use will this small slip of paper be against so many scrolls!” It will be said, “No injustice whatsoever will be done to you!” Then all those scrolls will be placed on one pan of the scale and that slip on the other pan. Because of the weight of that slip, the pan full of scrolls will fly (upward). Nothing has any value whatsoever before the blessed name of Allah (this is the truth).”
